summary: Two NotificationBell triggers side by side: one given three notifications and one given an empty list.
use: Comparing the populated and empty bell states for an app header or toolbar.
spec: `<NotificationBell notifications={items} />` with 3 const items (`id`, `title`, `body`, `time`, `read`), two with `read: false` and one with `read: true`
No callback props are passed to either bell
